title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a CSS Aspirant in Islamabad. Tip #1
body: He is doing CSS and it has become the entire personality, the whole schedule, and most of the conversation. Ask which attempt. First attempt is confidence. Second is strategy. Third is a man who has read more Pakistani history than the people who taught it to him. It's a sealed deal if he can name his optional subjects faster than his own siblings.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 CSS walo, respect, genuinely.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a CSS Aspirant in Islamabad. Tip #2
body: Watch where he studies. The National Library, the reading room in Aabpara, or a room at home with the door shut and a schedule taped to it that nobody in the family is allowed to interrupt. There is a whiteboard. There is a stack of Dawn editorials going back eleven months. It's a sealed deal if his mother has started answering the door for him so his flow isn't broken.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a CSS Aspirant in Islamabad. Tip #3
body: Ask about the academy. Everyone has done one, everyone complains about it, and everyone recommends a different one. There is a teacher in this city whose Pakistan Affairs notes have been photocopied so many times the diagrams have gone soft. It's a sealed deal if he owns a photocopied bundle whose original owner graduated before he started school.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a CSS Aspirant in Islamabad. Tip #4
body: Listen for the vocabulary leaking into normal speech. Governance, devolution, quota, federating units, and he uses them at dinner without noticing. His family has stopped asking follow-up questions. It's a sealed deal if he has explained the 18th Amendment to someone who did not ask.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a CSS Aspirant in Islamabad. Tip #5
body: Ask what happens if it doesn't work. Watch the pause, because that pause is the whole thing. There is a plan B involving a bank job or a master's abroad and he hates it. Everyone in his life is being careful around this subject. It's a sealed deal if a relative has asked about the result at a wedding, publicly, and he answered politely with his jaw locked.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a CSS Aspirant in Islamabad. Tip #6
body: Watch the group. Four or five of them, met at an academy, now closer than most siblings, sharing notes and past papers and a level of despair nobody outside can access. When one clears, the group changes forever and everyone knows it in advance. It's a sealed deal if their WhatsApp group is named something aspirational and slightly embarrassing.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a CSS Aspirant in Islamabad. Tip #7
body: Ask about the interview stage, because that's a different animal. Suit bought specifically. Panel questions nobody can prepare for. A story about being asked something absurd that he will tell for the rest of his life. It's a sealed deal if he can recite what he was asked, word for word, years later, and still argue about the answer.
